components.name: Camera settings model (parts ported from DynamicCam 2.21.5)
components.modifications: Camera.lua is a new file. Ported from DynamicCam: the standard-setting and built-in situation catalogue with priorities, wheel-increment rules (MouseZoom.lua), precedence of situation values and curves and the toggle-group transitions (ZoomBasedSettings.lua), situation selection, delay, zoom-action and zoom-restore rules (SituationManager.lua). Original: self-terminating driver, zoom and rotation tracking, data-only condition model, CVar write path, import and options page. No DynamicCam library, options or interface-hiding code is included.
